answer: Make identity earn its keep with a sequential work chain no farm can shortcut. Each puzzle's seed is the hash of the previous solution, a thread unwinding one step at a time. First, it solves step one and posts the proof. Second, each new seed derives from the last proof, so clones cannot split the work. Third, after 10,000 linked steps, 48 hours of compute, the chain verifies and the identity docks like a ship cleared at the wharf. A 1,000-clone farm needs 48,000 machine-hours, $4,800 at ten cents an hour. Like a lotus opening one petal at a time, trust arrives step by step.
